            SET slug = $3, name = $4, description = $5, enabled = $6, config = $7,
                webhook_token_hash = $8, default_agent_id = $9, project_id = $10,
                auto_run = $11, allow_writes = $12, archived = $13, updated_at = $14
            WHERE organization_id = $1 AND id = $2
